reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Henry Ward, co-founder and CEO of Carta.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Henry Ward, co-founder and CEO of Carta. Started in 2012, Carta helps companies and investors manage their cap tables, equity plans, and ownership. Last year, they launched CartaX, a platform for private companies and their employees to access secondary market liquidity.

key_points.text: Our discussion is a detailed exploration of private market infrastructure and Henry’s views on building an enduring business.
